reason: The aluminium already comes with factory film, and on my small house jobs I'd rather mask the odd frame with tape and cover than pay a new supplier about €19 a square metre. It's a new budget line for something my clients don't ask me to protect.
objection: I'd be paying €19 per m² plus a 50% deposit and a 150 m² minimum, for a problem the factory film mostly solves and that a few euro of tape and sheeting handles on my small jobs.
instead: Keep the factory film on until handover and use cheap protection film, tape and cardboard where needed. I'd clean up any splashes myself.
would_change_my_mind: A local contractor of my size showing me real handover claims for glazing damage that factory film didn't prevent, and a price near €6 to €8 per m² with no minimum and no deposit.
